He played [[college basketball]] for the [[Kentucky Wildcats men's basketball|Kentucky Wildcats]]. Johnson attended [[Oak Hill Academy (Mouth of Wilson, Virginia)|Oak Hill Academy]] in [[Mouth of Wilson, Virginia]]. He was selected in the first round of the [[2019 NBA draft]] by the Spurs with the 29th overall pick. In 2021, he won an Olympic gold medal in basketball as a member of the [[2020 United States men's Olympic basketball team|United States national team]]. Johnson was named the [[NBA Sixth Man of the Year]] with the Spurs in 2026 and reached the [[2026 NBA Finals|NBA Finals]] that same season. == Early life == Johnson was born in [[Chesterfield, Virginia]], a suburb of [[Richmond, Virginia|Richmond]], and grew up in the rural Virginia community of [[South Hill, Virginia|South Hill]].{{Cite web |last=Jeter |first=Fred |date=July 4, 2019 |title=NBA draftee Keldon Johnson has local roots |url=http://richmondfreepress.com/news/2019/jul/04/nba-draftee-keldon-johnson-has-local-roots/ |access-date=2025-12-11 |website=Richmond Free Press}} The son of a truck driver and a nurse, he grew up with three siblings.{{Cite web |last=Osborn |first=Tom |date=June 23, 2019 |title=Spurs' draft pick Keldon Johnson a 'really good country kid' |url=https://www.expressnews.com/sports/spurs/article/Spurs-draft-pick-Keldon-Johnson-a-really-14032101.php |access-date=December 11, 2025 |website=San Antonio Express-News}} Often called a "country boy,"{{Cite web |last=McDonald |first=Jeff |date=October 20, 2025 |title=How 'country boy' Keldon Johnson became keeper of the Spurs' culture |url=https://www.expressnews.com/sports/spurs/article/country-boy-keldon-johnson-keeper-spurs-culture-21109774.php |access-date=December 11, 2025 |website=San Antonio Express-News}}{{Cite web |last=Guzman |first=Matt |date=2025-10-22 |title=Now Longest-Tenured Spur, 'The Mustang' Ready to Ride Again |url=https://www.si.com/nba/spurs/onsi/news/the-mustang-now-longest-tenured-san-antonio-spur-keldon-johnson-ready-ride-again |access-date=2025-12-11 |website=San Antonio Spurs On SI |language=en-US}} he enjoyed fishing and hunting growing up.{{Cite web |date=2018-06-06 |title=Keldon Johnson |url=https://ukathletics.com/roster/keldon-johnson/ |access-date=2025-12-11 |website=UK Athletics |language=en-US}}{{Cite web |last=Staff |first=Mountain Eagle |date=2018-10-17 |title=Meet UK frosh Keldon Johnson - The Mountain Eagle |url=https://www.themountaineagle.com/articles/meet-uk-frosh-keldon-johnson/ |access-date=2025-12-11 |website=The Mountain Eagle -}}{{Cite web |last=Aguirre |first=Priscilla |date=February 13, 2022 |title=San Antonio Spurs forward Keldon Johnson finds peace off-court with hunting, fishing |url=https://www.mysanantonio.com/sports/spurs/article/spurs-keldon-johnson-hunting-fishing-16848668.php |access-date=December 11, 2025 |website=MySA}} ==High school career== Johnson played his freshman and sophomore high school seasons at [[Park View High School (South Hill, Virginia)|Park View High School]] in South Hill. His freshman basketball season, he broke the Virginia High School League ninth-grade scoring record by averaging just over 27 points per game, and he earned all-state first team honors as a sophomore, positioning himself as a top 15 national that year. He then joined the elite basketball programs at [[Huntington Prep School]] in West Virginia and [[Oak Hill Academy (Virginia)|Oak Hill Academy]] in Virginia, in his junior and senior years, respectively. During his time at Oak Hill, he was named the Virginia Gatorade High School Player of the Year and was selected to both the McDonald's All American Game and the Jordan Brand Classic Game. Johnson was rated as a five-star recruit and ranked as the 13th best player in the 2018 class by [[247Sports.com]].{{cite web |title=Keldon Johnson, Oak Hill Academy Warriors, Small Forward |url=https://247sports.com/Player/Keldon-Johnson-85162/high-school-201419/ |website=247Sports |access-date=16 February 2025}} He committed to [[University of Kentucky]] to play college basketball, being joined by fellow recruits [[Immanuel Quickley]], [[E. J. Montgomery]], [[Ashton Hagans]], and [[Tyler Herro]].{{Cite news|url=http://vaughtsviews.com/2018/05/keldon-johnson-same-level-as-great-players-steve-smith-has-coached-at-oak-hill/|title=Keldon Johnson "same level" as great players Steve Smith has coached at Oak Hill|date=May 7, 2018|work=Vaughts Views|access-date=May 27, 2018}}{{Cite news|url=https://www.seccountry.com/kentucky/kentucky-basketball-roster-nba-draft-decisions-recruits-reclassify|title=Choose your own Kentucky basketball adventure: Build 2018–19 Cats roster from available options|date=May 2, 2018|work=SEC Country|access-date=May 27, 2018}} {{College athlete recruit start|40=no|collapse=no|year=2018}} {{College athlete recruit entry | recruit = Keldon Johnson | position = [[Shooting guard|SG]]/[[Small Forward|SF]] | hometown = [[South Hill, Virginia|South Hill, VA]] | highschool = [[Oak Hill Academy (Mouth of Wilson, Virginia)|Oak Hill Academy]] (VA) | feet = 6 | inches = 6 | weight = 205 | 40 = | commitdate = November 11, 2017 | scout stars = | rivals stars = 5 | 247 stars = 5 | espn stars = 5 | espn grade = 94 }} {{College athlete recruit end | 40 = | year = 2018 | rivals ref title = Kentucky 2018 Basketball Commitments | scout ref title = | espn ref title = 2018 Kentucky Wildcats Recruiting Class | 247 ref title = | rivals school = kentucky | 247 school = | espn schoolid = 96 | scout overall = | rivals overall = 15 | 247 overall = 18 | espn overall = 7 | accessdate = June 4, 2018 | bball = yes }} ==College career== As a freshman, Johnson averaged 13.5 points and 5.9 rebounds per game, shooting 46.1 percent from the field and 38.1 percent from behind the arc. He scored 19 points in a win over top-ranked [[Tennessee Volunteers men's basketball|Tennessee]] on February 16, 2019. Johnson pulled down a career-high 17 rebounds in a victory over [[Auburn Tigers men's basketball|Auburn]]. Following the season he declared for the NBA draft.{{cite news |last1=Fisher |first1=Chris |title=Keldon Johnson declares for 2019 NBA Draft |url=https://247sports.com/college/kentucky/Article/Kentucky-basketball-Keldon-Johnson-declares-for-2019-NBA-Draft-131076343/ |access-date=June 26, 2019 |work=247 Sports |date=April 10, 2019}} ==Professional career== ===San Antonio Spurs (2019–present)=== On June 20, 2019, Johnson was selected with the 29th overall pick by the [[San Antonio Spurs]] in the [[2019 NBA draft]].{{cite news |last1=Orsborn |first1=Tom |title=Spurs select Kentucky's Keldon Johnson with 29th overall pick |url=https://www.chron.com/sports/spurs/article/Spurs-select-Kentucky-s-Keldon-Johnson-with-29th-14026944.php |access-date=June 26, 2019 |work=[[Houston Chronicle]] |date=June 20, 2019}} The Spurs obtained the draft pick used to draft Johnson in a 2018 trade; in that trade, Spurs small forward [[Kawhi Leonard]] was sent to the [[Toronto Raptors]] in exchange for Raptors shooting guard [[DeMar DeRozan]], center [[Jakob Pöltl]], and a draft choice.{{Cite web|url=https://airalamo.com/2020/08/11/san-antonio-spurs-keldon-johnson-kawhi-trade/|title=San Antonio Spurs: Keldon Johnson proving he's the prize of Kawhi trade|date=August 11, 2020}} Johnson was later listed in the roster of [[San Antonio Spurs]] for [[2019 NBA Summer League]] hosted at [[Vivint Arena]].{{cite web|title=SPURS ANNOUNCE 2019 SALT LAKE CITY SUMMER LEAGUE ROSTER|url=https://www.nba.com/spurs/spurs-announce-2019-salt-lake-city-summer-league-roster|date=June 26, 2019|website=NBA.com|access-date=June 26, 2019}} Johnson signed with the Spurs on July 1, 2019.{{cite web |title=SPURS SIGN 2019 FIRST ROUND PICK KELDON JOHNSON |url=https://www.nba.com/spurs/news/spurs-sign-2019-first-round-pick-keldon-johnson |website=NBA.com |access-date=July 1, 2019 |language=en}} On October 30, 2019, Johnson received his first assignment to the [[Austin Spurs]], the Spurs’ affiliate team in the [[NBA G League]].{{cite web |title=SPURS ASSIGN LUKA SAMANIC AND KELDON JOHNSON TO AUSTIN SPURS|url=https://www.nba.com/spurs/news/spurs-assign-luka-samanic-and-keldon-johnson-austin-spurs|date=October 30, 2019|website=NBA.com|access-date=October 30, 2019}} Johnson made his NBA debut on November 22, 2019, playing two minutes in a 115–104 loss to the Philadelphia 76ers. On August 11, 2020, Johnson scored a season-high 24 points in a 123–105 win over the [[Houston Rockets]] with eleven rebounds and three assists.{{cite web|url=https://www.espn.com/nba/recap?gameId=401224773|title=Spurs keep playoff hopes alive with 123–105 win over Rockets|date=August 11, 2020|website=ESPN.com|access-date=August 11, 2020}} On January 17, 2023, Johnson scored a career high 36 points along with 11 rebounds and 1 assist in a 106–98 win against the [[Brooklyn Nets]].{{cite web | url=https://www.nba.com/game/min-vs-sas-0022101024/box-score | title=Minnesota Timberwolves vs San Antonio Spurs Mar 14, 2022 Box Scores | website=[[NBA.com]] }} On July 18, 2022, Johnson signed a four-year, $80 million rookie scale contract extension with the Spurs.{{Cite web |title=SPURS SIGN KELDON JOHNSON TO CONTRACT EXTENSION |url=https://www.nba.com/spurs/news/spurs-sign-keldon-johnson-to-contract-extension |access-date=July 18, 2022 |website=NBA}}{{Cite web |title=San Antonio Spurs' Keldon Johnson agrees to 4-year, $80M extension |url=https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/34250986/san-antonio-spurs-keldon-johnson-agrees-4-year-80m-extension |access-date=July 18, 2022 |website=ESPN|date=July 16, 2022 }} On October 31, 2023, Johnson put up 27 points alongside a key steal on [[Kevin Durant]] that led to a game-winner in a 115–114 win over the [[Phoenix Suns]].{{cite web|url=https://clutchpoints.com/spurs-news-victor-wembanyamas-last-minute-heroics-set-stage-for-kevin-durants-epic-blunder-in-san-antonios-win-over-suns|title=Spurs: Victor Wembanyama sets stage for Kevin Durant choke, Keldon Johnson heroics|website=ClutchPoints|last=Pagaduan|first=Jedd|date=October 31, 2023|access-date=November 3, 2023}} [[File:Towns and Johnson, 2026 NBA Finals.png|thumb|Johnson in Game 3 of the [[2026 NBA Finals]]]] As of the [[2025–26 NBA season|2025–26 season]], Johnson is the longest tenured player on the Spurs. He was named [[NBA Sixth Man of the Year]] that season.{{Cite web |last=Wright |first=Michael |date=2026-04-22 |title=Spurs' Keldon Johnson named NBA Sixth Man of the Year |url=https://www.espn.com.au/nba/story/_/id/48563850/san-antonio-spurs-keldon-johnson-named-nba-sixth-man-year |access-date=2026-04-22 |website=ESPN.com |language=en}} Appearing in all 82 games for San Antonio as a reserve, Johnson recorded averages of 13.2 points, 5.4 rebounds, and 1.4 assists.{{Cite web|title=Here Are The NBA's 2026-26 Iron Men. How Do They Compare To Years Past?|url=https://www.si.com/nba/iron-men-players-all-82-games-list-compared-years-past|access-date=July 31, 2026|website=si.com|language=en}} == National team career == Johnson trained with the USA Men's Junior National Team in 2017 and 2018. In 2021, he was named to the USA Select team on July 1, then added to the [[United States men's national basketball team|men's national team]] on July 10, training with the [[2020 United States men's Olympic basketball team|2020 U.S. Olympic team]].{{Cite web |title=Keldon Johnson |url=https://www.usab.com/players/keldon-johnson-1 |access-date=2025-12-11 |website=USA Basketball |language=en}} On July 16, 2021, Johnson and center [[JaVale McGee]] were named to the Olympic roster in place of the injured [[Kevin Love]] and [[Bradley Beal]], who was kept from traveling to Tokyo for health and safety protocols.{{Cite web |date=July 16, 2021 |title=Johnson, McGee replace Love, Beal for Olympics |url=https://www.espn.com/olympics/story/_/id/31827912/cleveland-cavaliers-kevin-love-withdrawing-team-usa-tokyo-olympics |access-date=2025-12-06 |website=ESPN.com|agency=Associated Press |language=en}} Johnson played in four of six games, averaging 5.5 minutes. ==Personal life== Johnson majored in undeclared/exploratory studies in agriculture during his college time.{{cite web|url=https://ukathletics.com/sports/mens-basketball/roster/keldon-johnson/6789|title=Keldon Johnson – Men's Basketball – University of Kentucky Athletics|website=ukathletics.com|date=June 6, 2018 |access-date=July 1, 2019}} He enjoys [[fishing]], [[hunting]], and the outdoors.{{Cite web |last=Spears |first=Marc J. |date=2022-02-09 |title='It's OK to be different': Spurs forward Keldon Johnson feels at home outdoors |url=https://andscape.com/features/its-ok-to-be-different-spurs-forward-keldon-johnson-feels-at-home-outdoors/ |access-date=2023-09-04 |website=Andscape |language=en-US}} Since 2021, Johnson has lived in a ranch home outside of San Antonio in the [[Texas Hill Country]]; an animal lover, he has numerous goats, chickens, dogs, miniature cows, and horses.{{Cite news |last=Weiss |first=Jared |date=2026-04-13 |title=A day on the ranch with Keldon Johnson, Spurs' heart and soul and NBA Sixth Man favorite |url=https://www.nytimes.com/athletic/7187330/2026/04/11/keldon-johnson-spurs-sixth-man-award-ranch/ |access-date=2026-04-13 |work=The New York Times |language=en-US |issn=0362-4331}} He maintains a collection of cowboy hats and boots. Johnson's brother Kaleb also played college basketball, for [[Georgetown Hoyas men's basketball|Georgetown University]] during 2015–2019, and was drafted 34th overall by the [[Austin Spurs]] in the [[2021 NBA G League draft (January)|January 2021 NBA G League draft]].{{cite web |title=Austin Spurs select Jonathan Kasibabu, Anthony Mathis and Kaleb Johnson in 2021 NBA G League draft|url=https://austin.gleague.nba.com/news/austin-spurs-select-jonathan-kasibabu-anthony-mathis-and-kaleb-johnson-in-2021-nba-g-league-draft|date=January 11, 2021|website=NBA.com|access-date=January 11, 2021}} Kaleb plays for the [[Valley Suns]] following a trade the Austin Spurs made.{{cite news |title=Valley Suns acquire Kaleb Johnson in trade with
